propositions: The Jira reconciler package lives at src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ and uses 47 by-path loaders (lazy_load, spec_from_file_location, sys.path.insert) across src/ and tests/ that must be deleted by moving the package to rebar.reconciler as an ordinary subpackage.

The bridge subprocess chain has three hops (_bridge_runner → rebar bridge sync → python -m rebar_reconciler) that must collapse to a direct spawn of python -m rebar.reconciler from _bridge_runner with process-group reaping via the existing rebar._proc.reap_process_group helper on timeout.

Three retired rollback env vars (REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE, REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE, REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP) gate code paths and must be deleted after promoting fail-loud to unconditional.
Five dormant modules and half of outbound_fields.py (675 LOC dead code) with dead MutationAction pairs and _call_with_retry must be deleted and their tests removed.
Bridge scratch must move from bridge_state/ at repo root to .rebar/bridge/ with keep-last-5 retention (snapshots and sync logs) and a 30-day alert window, pruned on every persisted pass.

Ratchet baseline files (.github/complexity-baseline.json and .github/mechanism-baseline.json) must have keys re-spelled to reflect the package move with no ceiling or count changes; operator sanction required in commit messages.
